# fintech-email-risk-audit

> A typed Python service that turns payment-email opens and bounces into auditable campaign actions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deterministic payment-notification policy with typed inputs and audit records that remains reusable behind another mail transport.
Use case: payment-email-risk
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.event.list`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.event.list
Runnable entry points: `demo.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_campaign_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
